opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researcher with permanent or fixed‑term position, based at a UK university or not‑for‑profit research organisation, must have teaching and admin duties, lead applicant must be UK‑based.
opportunities.summary: Interdisciplinary, curiosity‑driven research funding for established researchers to pursue cross‑disciplinary projects benefiting wider society.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any UK‑based researcher across all career stages; must partner with a GLAM or performing‑arts organisation.
opportunities.summary: Funding for public‑engagement projects that connect humanities and social sciences research with galleries, libraries, archives, museums or performing‑arts organisations.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in humanities or social sciences, based at a UK university or recognised research organisation; UK/EU nationals eligible; must be post‑doctoral and not hold a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships for early‑career researchers to undertake independent, publishable research and develop teaching experience.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers with a long‑term appointment at a UK HEI or independent research organisation, working in humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Supports skill and capacity development (e.g., quantitative, data‑science, digital humanities, languages) for researchers at any career stage.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigators (post‑doctoral level or above) in humanities or social sciences, with international co‑applicants; interdisciplinary collaboration across SHAPE and STEM required.
opportunities.summary: Two‑year projects on mobilities, encouraging genuine interdisciplinary work between humanities/social sciences and any STEM discipline.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑ and mid‑career UK‑based researchers in humanities or social sciences; no specific disciplinary restriction; must be able to work in Berlin with DGAP.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships hosted at DGAP in Berlin, focusing on policy‑relevant analysis in areas such as security, Indo‑European relations, technology and AI, or European strategy‑making.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs

amount.raw: up to £4,000 (exceptionally higher amounts may be considered)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months.
opportunities.summary: Provides up‑to‑£4,000 (or higher in exceptional cases) to support additional needs such as equipment, caring costs, or assistance with application preparation.

opportunities.title: Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers affiliated with UK or German research institutions.
opportunities.summary: Symposium attendance for ~15 UK and 15 German early‑career researchers on ‘Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future’, with seed funding for collaborative projects.
